notes.title: Fireside Fables Kickstarter Launches April 1st!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332953/ffefb174751dcda475c535d89fa9262afef5f880.png

Fireside Fables Kickstarter Launches April 1st!

Our Kickstarter Campaign for Fireside Fables finally has a launch date!

To celebrate, we have a brand new trailer to show off! Check it out here - [previewyoutube=KSjxG02mFd8;full][/previewyoutube]

Fireside Fables is a cozy narrative driven 3D platformer, made in partnership with Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity! Play through your plushies greatest adventures, explore whimsical worlds, and re-discover your inner child!

Releasing on PC, Xbox Series X/S, Playstation 5 and Nintendo Switch in Q4 2025!

Follow along our Kickstarter NOW here - https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/inkforgestudios/fireside-fables
